author: yoloboy71
body: i was banned for suicide encouragement even though i said jk and it was directed to a friend whom knew i was joking which i though was utter bullshit, but anyways, i appealed multiple times and was told to apply a month or so later and here I am writing this appeal. id like to appeal because i love avicus and i have been playing for years and being banned really makes me sad. i also now know not to say kys even if it was not meant. so yeah, thank you for reading and please consider unbanning me. thanks <3
